patches.title: Sample read API for the deck plan
patches.why: The Holodeck needs the ship's rooms from a real endpoint, not fixtures.

patches.title: Sample patch for the patch bay
patches.why: A small patch to rehearse the whole line before a real one.

patches.title: apply.sh can run twice
patches.why: Running the apply script again should change nothing, not stack a patch twice.

patches.title: Split or solo, measured
patches.why: Find out whether splitting a card across the three engineers beats one engineer doing it all.

patches.title: Thinking defaults per station
patches.why: Each station gets the reasoning level its work needs, written down once.

patches.title: Routing rules in the default prompt
patches.why: Number One reads the routing rules on every turn.

patches.title: Token cap on local profiles
patches.why: Local answers stop at a sane length instead of running on.

patches.title: Reminder send time fix
patches.why: Reminders fire at the time asked, from code, not from the model.

check.note: Every applied patch is still in place after the last Hermes update.

commands.label: Back up first
commands.cmd: sudo docker exec hermes tar czf /opt/data/backups/before-patch.tgz -C /opt/data config.yaml patches

commands.label: Apply the patches
commands.cmd: sudo docker exec -u root hermes sh /opt/data/patches/apply.sh
commands.when: After you approve a patch at review.

commands.label: Check them
commands.cmd: sudo docker exec -u root hermes sh /opt/data/patches/check.sh
commands.when: After an apply, and after every Hermes update.

commands.label: Restart Hermes
commands.when: When check.sh says all patches are present.

experiment.name: Split or solo
experiment.question: Is a card done faster and with less rework when the Chief splits it for Systems and Diagnostics, or when one engineer does it all?
